config.title: Indoor Playgrounds in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: What Berlin's indoor playgrounds and children's museums cost, when they open, and how to pay less.

items.q: What are the best indoor playgrounds in Berlin?
items.a: The four big halls are **JOLOs Kinderwelt** in Kreuzberg, **Bambooland** in Spandau, **Bim & Boom** in Marzahn and **Tommys Tobewelt** in Weißensee. Calmer and closer to the centre are the **MACHmit! Museum** in Prenzlauer Berg and the **Labyrinth Kindermuseum** in Wedding.

items.q: How much does an indoor playground cost in Berlin?
items.a: Children pay about **10.50 to 15 euros** at the big halls and adults **7.50 to 11 euros**. One Saturday afternoon for two adults, a five-year-old and a two-year-old cost between **41 and 50 euros** in the halls, **34 euros** at MACHmit! and **23 euros** at the Labyrinth when checked on 10 October 2026.

items.q: Do adults have to pay at Berlin indoor playgrounds?
items.a: Yes, at all four big halls. JOLOs charges adults **8 or 9 euros**, Bambooland **7.50 or 10**, Bim & Boom **7.50 or 10.50** and Tommys **9 or 11** online. The two museums sell **family tickets** that cover the adults.

items.q: Are Berlin indoor playgrounds more expensive in the school holidays?
items.a: At **JOLOs, Bim & Boom and Tommys** every school holiday day costs the weekend price. Bambooland's price list goes by weekday only. The Herbstferien run from **19 to 31 October 2026**.

items.q: Which indoor playground in Berlin is open on Monday?
items.a: Outside the school holidays only **Bambooland**, from 12:00 in the winter months, and **Tommys Tobewelt**, from 14:00. JOLOs, Bim & Boom and both museums are closed on a normal Monday.

items.q: How can I pay less at a Berlin indoor playground?
items.a: Go to **Bim & Boom after 17:00** on a Tuesday to Friday for half price, use the **Labyrinth's 5-euro Freutag** on Fridays outside the holidays, keep a Bambooland visit **under 110 minutes**, and buy Tommys tickets **online**, which saves 5 euros a ticket.
